chapter_seo_title: Dao Guai Yi Xian Ch 159 – Li Huowang vs the Mob in a Desperate Siege
chapter_meta_description: Cornered by a Zuowandao liar and a mob of grieving bandits, Li Huowang fights tooth and nail—literally. A severed arm settles the score in the bloodiest way possible.
og_title: Ch 159: Erbing – The Mob Closes In
og_description: Li Huowang faces a furious mob convinced he’s Danyangzi. Bai Lingmiao is wounded. Gao Zhijian falls. And then… the arm.
twitter_title: Dao Guai Yi Xian Ch 159 – They Framed Him, He Broke Them
twitter_description: A Zuowandao turns the crowd against Li Huowang. His response? Pull his own teeth, fling shrapnel, then cut off his arm and kill her with it. Hardcore.
